scope.reason: Re-read common-court opening recitals as whole sentences when the editor lays them out across adjacent lines. A clerk's closing mark printed after the decision is read as a publisher note rather than head matter; paragraph roles have no feature storage of their own. Read letter-spaced emphasis through the one shared reading, once a paragraph's lines are joined: a short spaced word in a text that spaces words, a row of one-letter words no sentence writes, and uneven chunks the document prints nowhere else read as the words they spell; only whitespace in block text changes and it has no feature storage of its own.
